questions.text: What should an agenda tell people before a meeting?

options.text: The topics, intended outcomes and time for each item
Everything the organiser knows about the topic

questions.explanation: An agenda sets out the topics, intended outcomes and time for each item so people can prepare.

questions.text: Which task belongs to the person taking notes?

options.text: Make every decision for the group
Speak for everyone who stays quiet
Record decisions, action owners and deadlines

questions.explanation: The note taker records decisions, action owners and deadlines. The group makes the decisions.

questions.text: One person dominates the discussion. What should the facilitator do?

options.text: Pause and invite others to contribute
Let them speak until the meeting ends
Ask the note taker to decide for everyone

questions.explanation: The facilitator makes room for other people to contribute. This question also checks your understanding of meeting roles.

questions.text: What should you confirm before the meeting ends?

options.text: That everyone spoke for the same amount of time
The decisions, who will act and by when
That another meeting is already booked

questions.explanation: Confirm decisions, action owners and deadlines. This question also checks the roles and discussion sections it builds on.
